primaryPolicyEvidence.observation: Primary policy permits original fan gameplay videos on video sites and YouTube Partner Program use under listed conditions. Third-party content rights remain separate.
conditions: Creative/editorial game explanation with attribution; no standalone sale or paywalled game-content distribution.
Only the silent selected gameplay excerpt is adopted; original soundtrack/dialogue is preserved in audit media but excluded.

primaryPolicyEvidence.title: Nintendo Game Content Guidelines
primaryPolicyEvidence.observation: Released Nintendo game footage with original creative/commentary input is permitted for individual consumers on appropriate sites; YouTube Partner Program is listed.
conditions: Original authored explanation and editorial input required; no mere gameplay-copy distribution.
Individual-consumer scope; no Nintendo endorsement implication.
Third-party rights separate; no unauthorized software/emulator/modification material selected.
Original source audio excluded from our cut; no separate extraction/distribution of game music.

primaryPolicyEvidence.title: Valve Video Policy
primaryPolicyEvidence.observation: Valve-content video publishing and YouTube Partner Program monetization are permitted; paid access/sale/licensing and third-party content remain limited.
conditions: No charge to view/access or selling/licensing the video for payment.
Third-party rights separate; adopt silent selected game images only.
